about.intro_content: Prof. Pei-Rong Ding is Professor, Chief Surgeon and Director of the Department of Colorectal Surgery at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou. He treats primary, metastatic and recurrent colorectal cancer, gastrointestinal stromal tumours and neuroendocrine tumours.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Ding is skilled in minimally invasive and nerve-sparing surgical techniques that preserve sphincter, bladder and sexual function in rectal surgery. His research focuses on screening and management of hereditary and early-onset colorectal cancer, optimisation of neoadjuvant therapy for locally advanced rectal cancer, and the impact of the tumour microenvironment on immunotherapy response. He leads clinical trials exploring improved treatment models for rectal cancer and Lynch syndrome, and has published more than 30 papers in journals including the Journal of the National Cancer Institute, Annals of Surgery, European Journal of Cancer and Oncoimmunology.

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Pei-Rong Ding

items.question: Does Prof. Pei-Rong Ding accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to colorectal or rectal cancer at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Ding's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Ding specialises in rectal and colorectal cancer surgery, with a research focus on hereditary colorectal cancer screening and optimisation of neoadjuvant therapy.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: Does Prof. Ding treat Lynch syndrome-related colorectal cancer?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Ding has led universal Lynch syndrome screening programmes in Chinese colorectal cancer patients and continues to lead clinical trials exploring improved treatment models for Lynch syndrome.

items.question: What surgical techniques does Prof. Ding use for rectal cancer?
items.answer: Prof. Ding is skilled in minimally invasive and nerve-sparing surgical techniques designed to preserve sphincter, bladder and sexual function during rectal cancer surgery.
